QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Meet Hiver 1
QuestInfo.0: #p1013000# looks like he wants to tell you something.
QuestInfo.1: #p1013000# doesn't think you'll be able to find #p1013203# without some detective work. The Black Wings may have some information and #p2152016# in #m310000000# appears to be a person of high rank. It might be worth looking into.
QuestInfo.2: #p2152016# seemed caught off-guard when you asked about #p1013203#. He certainly appears to be a high ranking member of the Black Wings, but...

0.0: We're going to have a hard time finding #p1013203# standing around here. He seems a bit evanescent... \r\n#L0##bEvanescent? Are you studying for the SAT or something?#l\n#k
0.1: One of us has to try and better ourselves. If you want to find #p1013203#, ask some of the other Black Wings. If you act nice, they might just tell you.\r\n#L0# #bI guess it doesn't hurt to ask...#l\n#k
0.2: It might hurt, but not me! Why don't you start off with #p2152016# in #m310000000#. He doesn't do anything but eat and stare into the distance. I bet he's got a fancy title!\r\n#L0##bThat almost makes sense. Do you think he'd let me ask him about #p1013203#?#l\n#k
0.3: He might! Hurry up and find out!

no.0: Don't chicken out! Are you afraid of #p1013203#?

1.0: Nom nom nom nom... What? The Black Wings are busy protecting this town. I don't have time for your nonsense.\r\n#L0##bI'm looking for a guy named #p1013203#. Do you know where I can find him?#l\n#k
1.1: *cough* *cough* Wha-what? You want to meet #p1013203#? What could a kid like you possibly have to do with him?!\r\n#L0# #bI... owe him 30 Mesos. It's really weighing on my shoulders.#l\n#k
1.2: Why would you borrow money from THAT guy?! ...You're going to have a hard time finding him without my help. I'll try to put you in touch.

npc.0: #p2152016# in #m310000000#... His fries look so tasty...
